meta.title: About AirGrid – Drone Experts in Belgium
meta.description: Learn about AirGrid's aerial photography mission, team, and values.
meta.keywords: AirGrid, drone, photography, Belgium, about us, aerial services

about_text: We’re a drone-powered creative studio capturing spaces, stories, and scenes from above. Rooted in real estate and driven by design, we turn ordinary perspectives into standout visuals. From homes to high-rises, groundbreakings to grand openings, we deliver clean, cinematic imagery with precision and purpose. Whether you're selling, showcasing, or storytelling. AirGrid elevates the way people see your world
about_why_text: We believe quality visuals shouldn’t come with unpredictable pricing or inconsistent service. At AirGrid, we combine cinematic craftsmanship, best-in-class drone practices, and transparent, fair pricing. Every flight is backed by full compliance with Belgian drone regulations and years of visual storytelling experience. You’re not just hiring a drone, you’re investing in a creative partner.
about_me_text: I got into drones a few years ago. What started as a hobby quickly evolved into a creative passion and a business: capturing aerial visuals that feel cinematic but grounded in purpose. I bring more than just flight skills, I bring an eye for detail, a feel for composition, and a love for telling stories from above. Whether it’s a cozy home or a commercial development, I’m here to help you see it differently.
about_locations_text: We currently operate across West Flanders and East Flanders, Belgium, including but not limited to:West Flanders: Knokke, Bruges, Kortrijk, Roeselare, Ostend, etc. Looking for a location not listed? Reach out, we’re flexible and expanding!
